title: Galaxy Forge public product catalog
description: 100 digital products as listed on the Galaxy Forge storefront: id, title, list price, link, format and summary.
intended_use: Internal reference format for the Data Products arm; a machine-readable copy of the public catalog.
out_of_scope_use: Not a sales or demand dataset: it contains no sales, traffic or customer data.
collection_method: Copied from the factory's own catalog file, which is generated from data/product_registry.json (read-only Gumroad catalog reads).

columns.name: price_usd_cents
columns.description: Recorded list price in US cents, before taxes

columns.name: url
columns.description: Product page on the factory's own Gumroad storefront

columns.name: featured
columns.description: Shown in the storefront's featured section

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Factory-written product summary (may be truncated with '...')

known_limitations: summaries are truncated as on the storefront
prices are list prices; checkout totals may differ (taxes)
a snapshot: the live catalog changes after this date
